relations.product: central corporate support services (IT, procurement, human resources, accounting, tax) from the Siemens Group
relations.quote: In fiscal year 2025, Siemens Healthineers obtained support services from the Siemens Group for central corporate services such as IT, procurement, human resources, accounting, or tax with a total value of €286 million (2024: €298 million).
relations.label: Siemens Healthineers annual report: Annual Report 2025 (11-26-2025)

relations.product: trademark and name-use license for the 'Siemens' and 'Siemens Healthineers' designations
relations.quote: Siemens AG has entered into trademark and name-use licensing agreements with Siemens Healthineers AG and some of its subsidiaries. Under such agreements, Siemens AG grants the respective licensee the right to use, in particular, the designations “Siemens” and “Siemens Healthineers” as a product brand, corporate brand and part of the company name
relations.label: Siemens Healthineers annual report: Annual Report 2025 (11-26-2025)

relations.product: imaging and therapeutic technologies under a new 10-year strategic alliance, plus a jointly developed theranostics cancer treatment program
relations.quote: We are further strengthening our 35-year-long relationship with Cleveland Clinic, one of the leading healthcare systems in the U.S. We are moving to the next level of cooperation with a new 10-year strategic alliance. For Cleveland Clinic, we will not only be the provider of multiple imaging and therapeutic technologies, but also jointly develop a state-of-the-art theranostics cancer treatment program.
relations.label: Siemens Healthineers Q3 FY2026 (07-31-2026)

relations.product: advanced diagnostic imaging and radiation oncology technology under a multi-year value partnership
relations.quote: We also signed a multi-year value partnership with Vanderbilt Health, a nationally recognized top-tier academic medical center. In this partnership, we will also serve as the provider of advanced technology for diagnostic imaging and radiation oncology.
relations.label: Siemens Healthineers Q3 FY2026 (07-31-2026)
